messages:
nina: Quick postmortem follow-up \/ action tracker: recurring paging from cache latency overnight (memcache/redis). Need a short plan: owners, quick mitigations, validation metrics.

mark: I can own the alert rule audit. Plan: enumerate memcache_* alerts, tag by cluster, and propose per-cluster thresholds. ETA 48h for initial pass.

priya: +1. also propose a statistical suppression layer: only page if the p99 is above threshold AND the anomaly score > 2 for 5m. that catches flappy hosts.

mark: can you sketch the anomaly check?

priya: thinking simple: z-score on a 7d rolling window. if z > 2 for 5m then allow page. otherwise log to #alerts-ops.

oncall-bot: Reminder: any change that reduces paging must include an eval plan in infra/runbooks per policy.

devops-ci: ops note: we can feature-flag the suppression rule. sample Prometheus-ish rule we used for testing:
```yaml
- alert: cache_latency_p99_suppressed
  expr: |
    (
      histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, host, cluster))
      > 150
    ) and on(host)
    (cache_latency_zscore > 2)
  for: 3m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Applying under feature flag in staging first.

nina: owners + ETAs suggestion: mark -> rule audit + PR (48h), priya -> suppression prototype + test (72h), devops-ci -> feature-flag rollout and runbook patch (today start, deploy in 1 business day), nina -> validation dashboard + baseline (tomorrow AM). Agree?

mark: agree. will create a checklist in the RFC PR and link here.

priya: will push prototype as a microservice metric exporter (zscore) and expose cache_latency_zscore. ETA 72h.

devops-ci: starting runbook edit now. temp hush:
```
opsctl silence add --team oncall --alert cache_latency_p99 --duration 6h --reason "postmortem noise - tuning" --confirm
```
Doing dry-run first.

nina: validation metrics to track (short list): total cache alerts/day, pages/night (22:00-06:00), uniq_hosts_per_alert, false_positive_rate estimate. Target: night pages -70% within two weeks.

oncall-bot: Auto: new runbook PR required -> tag @eng-sre for review.

mark: quick question: do we want a dedupe window per host or per cluster? my vote: per-host 10m + cluster cooldown 30m.

priya: per-host dedupe reduces repeated paging on flapping host, cluster cooldown prevents thundering herd. works.

nina: scheduling: short progress check Wed 09:00 PT. if blockers post here. I'll own follow-ups and update the incident action tracker.

devops-ci: pushed stub PR for runbook and flagged feature flag. link: https://git.internal/infra/runbooks/pulls/1123

mark: PR for alert audit incoming, will link this thread.

priya: prototype metric exporter pushed to staging, tests running. will post results by EOD.

nina: thanks team. keep updates short. :white_check_mark:
